Rice.guidance: Requires flooded or moist soil conditions and warm humid climate.

Maize.guidance: Well-drained loamy soil, sensitive to waterlogging.

Chickpea.guidance: Cool climate, light to deep black soils, drought-tolerant legume.

Kidneybeans.guidance: Prefers rich, well-drained loamy soil with neutral pH.

Pigeonpeas.guidance: Deep root system, deep black or well-drained loam.

Mothbeans.guidance: Extremely drought-resistant, suited for arid and semi-arid regions.

Mungbean.guidance: Warm climate, well-drained loam or alluvial soils.

Blackgram.guidance: Heavy soils like vertisols, requires moderate moisture.

Lentil.guidance: Cool season legume, light loams and alluvial soils.

Pomegranate.guidance: Semi-arid climate, deep loamy soils, drip irrigation recommended.

Banana.guidance: High nutrient feeder, rich organic soils with adequate drainage.

Mango.guidance: Tropical climate, deep alluvial or loamy soils.

Grapes.guidance: Well-drained sandy loam or clay loam with high potash.

Watermelon.guidance: Warm dry climate, sandy loams with organic matter.

Muskmelon.guidance: High sunshine, warm nights, well-drained sandy soil.

Apple.guidance: Hill stations, rich well-aerated loamy soil.

Papaya.guidance: Tropical climate, fertile well-drained soil, avoid water stagnation.

Coconut.guidance: Coastal and high humidity regions, deep sandy loam.

Cotton.guidance: Black cotton soil (vertisols), warm climate, moderate moisture.

Jute.guidance: Warm and wet climate, fertile alluvial plains.

Coffee.guidance: Highlands with shade, well-drained humus-rich acidic soil.
